sources.title: Patrick Roque: Naga Plaza Rizal, 15 April 2023
sources.note: CC BY-SA 4.0. Independent photograph: paved monument forecourt, mature broadleaved trees, low planted islands, stone edges and single-globe ornamental lamps. Geometry and dimensions are illustrative estimates fitted to OSM, not surveyed or dated features.

sources.title: Patrick Roque: Naga Plaza Rizal road view, 15 April 2023
sources.note: CC BY-SA 4.0. Independent photograph: Philippine flagpole, planted monument forecourt and the southern bandstand with a hipped roof. Roof contours, platform and support sizes are illustrative estimates.

sources.title: Project owner: Plaza Rizal reference views, 1 October 2026
sources.note: Owner-requested full plaza detail: northern open paving, curved planted seating islands, mature crowns, perimeter timber pergolas with planting, and a southern bandstand. Supplied Google Maps/Street View screenshots are not distributed, georeferenced or traced; the authored layout is a schematic estimate anchored to the OSM plaza and independently photographed features. Pergola dimensions and individual planting positions need a ground survey.

sources.title: Project owner: raised forecourt, 1 October 2026
sources.note: Owner-requested raised monument/flagpole forecourt with four broad front steps and matching back steps. Heights (0.6 m terrace, 0.15 m rises), tread widths and footprints are illustrative estimates fitted to OSM; the back steps follow the owner's requested layout and match the front stair profile. No construction date is inferred.
